Goa Nightclub Fire: High Court Orders Owners to Pay Victims' Families

The Bombay High Court has ordered the owners of a Goa nightclub, identified as the Luthra brothers, to deposit Rs 20 lakh each as interim aid for the families of victims of a recent fire incident. The court's directive comes in response to the nightclub fire.
